# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Applied two amendments to the volume-independence regression tests in crates/tank_core/tests/cycling.rs: (1) Added DO (dissolved oxygen) and alkalinity per-liter delta assertions to both tests, closing the gap where a volume-dependent bug in the stoichiometric DO/alkalinity bookkeeping code paths (lines 230-235, 288-289, 332-334, 362-364 of nitrogen_cycle.rs) would not have been caught. (2) Added the full Monod factor verification section to the extreme-scale test (1L vs 1000L), which previously only checked per-liter deltas. Both tests now verify all seven species (TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON, DO, alkalinity) for delta equality and five Monod factors for pre-tick equality. The third pending amendment (substrate area multiplier preservation) is out of scope for this test-only bead.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Read current state of cycling.rs and nitrogen_cycle.rs to understand the K_s field migration (legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l removed, fields now native concentration units)
2. [Completed] Amendment 1: Added DO and alkalinity to the before() closure and delta assertions in concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent, including a non-zero DO delta sanity check
3. [Completed] Amendment 1 (extreme): Added DO and alkalinity to the concs() closure and pairs array in concentration_kinetics_volume_independent_extreme_scales, including a non-zero DO delta sanity check
4. [Completed] Amendment 2: Added full Monod factor verification block (5 factors: TAN, NO2, DOC, DO-AOB, DO-decomp) to the extreme-scale test, matching the primary test's coverage
5. [Skipped] Amendment 3 (substrate area multiplier preservation): Skipped — out of scope for this test-only bead (tanksim-6e5.2.3.5)
6. [Completed] Ran rustfmt, cargo clippy, and cargo test to validate: formatting clean, no clippy warnings, both amended tests pass, 17/18 cycling tests pass (1 pre-existing unrelated failure in aob_growth_reserves_tan)

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --test cycling concentration_kinetics: 2 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test cycling: 17 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing failure in aob_growth_reserves_tan_for_assimilation_when_tan_would_otherwise_hit_zero, unrelated to this bead)
- cargo clippy --test cycling -- -W clippy::all: no warnings from cycling.rs
- rustfmt --check crates/tank_core/tests/cycling.rs: no formatting issues
- Primary test now asserts 7 per-liter deltas (TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON, DO, alkalinity) plus 5 Monod factors
- Extreme-scale test now asserts 7 per-liter deltas plus 5 Monod factors (previously only 5 deltas, no Monod factors)
- Both tests include non-zero DO delta sanity checks confirming DO assertions are not vacuously passing

## Outstanding Risks

- Pending amendment 3 (substrate area multiplier preservation in resolved_colonizable_area_factor, refresh_habitat_registry, and migrate_v6_to_v7) was not applied — it is out of scope for this test-only bead and should be tracked as a separate task.
- The pre-existing failure in aob_growth_reserves_tan_for_assimilation_when_tan_would_otherwise_hit_zero (line 400: residual TAN slightly above 1e-9 after K_s migration) is unrelated to this bead but affects the cycling test suite.
